title: American Truck Simulator

verdict.summary: American Truck Simulator is only out on computers right now, so there is no console crossplay; the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions are announced but have no release date.

notes: Online play is the built-in Convoy mode, added in update 1.41. One player hosts a session for up to 8 drivers, and friends join through Steam. Sessions only show up for players in the same region, so a friend far away may need to switch their Steam download region or search for the session by its exact name.
You don't need to own the map DLCs to join a convoy, but you can't drive into DLC areas you don't own.
The game runs on Windows, Mac and Linux. We couldn't find an official statement that Mac and Linux players can join Windows sessions, so treat that as unconfirmed.

SCS Software announced PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions in August 2025 but hasn't given a release date. In April 2026 it said the console ports are still being worked on and that it will only announce a date when they're ready. Nothing has been said about console crossplay yet.

title: Watch Dogs 2

verdict.summary: Watch Dogs 2 has no crossplay: PlayStation, Xbox and PC players each play online only with their own platform.

notes: Ubisoft Support has confirmed that crossplay isn't available in Watch Dogs 2. Online modes (2 player co-op, 4 player party, Bounty Hunter, Hacking Invasion, Online Racing and Showd0wn) unlock after the A Walk in the Park mission and are started from the in-game phone.
On PC, the Steam version runs through Ubisoft Connect. Ubisoft Support says Steam players need to link their Steam account to a Ubisoft account to play with friends who own it on Ubisoft Connect.
Watch Dogs 2's online services are still running. It is not on Ubisoft's list of retired online services (checked October 2026), which does include the original Watch Dogs on Wii U.

title: Dark Souls: Remastered

verdict.summary: Dark Souls: Remastered has no crossplay: Bandai Namco confirmed that players are matched only with others on the same platform.

notes: Bandai Namco confirmed before launch that the remaster wouldn't support cross-platform play, so co-op and PvP only happen with players on the same platform.

The remaster moved matchmaking to dedicated servers, raised the online limit from 4 to 6 players (unlocked with the Dried Finger), and added password matchmaking, so friends can find each other's summon signs by setting the same password.

PC online play was switched off on January 23, 2022 after a security flaw was found, and came back for the remaster on November 9, 2022. The older Prepare to Die Edition on PC never got its online features back.

title: Devil May Cry 5

verdict.summary: Devil May Cry 5 has no crossplay and no regular co-op: its only online feature, the Cameo System, randomly drops other players into your missions, and Capcom has never announced cross-platform support for it.

notes: There's no split-screen and no way to invite a friend. Online, the Cameo System (also called Shared Single-Play) can show another player, live or as a recording of their run, fighting in the same area on missions where the story puts two heroes together. Afterwards you can rate their style.
Capcom has never announced crossplay for the game, and we found no official word on whether cameos can come from other platforms.
Devil May Cry 5 Special Edition, with Vergil playable, came out digitally on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S in November 2020.

The Switch 2 version, Devil May Cry 5 Devil Hunter Edition, came out digitally on June 23, 2026 (physical on August 28, 2026). Capcom says it doesn't include the online Shared Single-Play feature, and Nintendo's listing shows it as a one-player game.

title: Assetto Corsa

verdict.summary: The original Assetto Corsa has no crossplay: PC, PlayStation and Xbox players race online only with their own platform.

notes: Each platform has its own online pool. Neither the Xbox nor the PlayStation store listing mentions crossplay (both list online races for up to 16 players), and no crossplay update has ever been announced.

The Xbox One version also runs on Xbox Series X|S and through Xbox Cloud Gaming, and the PS4 version is playable on PS5. Online play on console needs PS Plus or a Game Pass tier that includes online play.
This page is about the 2014 original. Assetto Corsa Competizione and Assetto Corsa EVO are separate games with their own rules.

title: Delta Force
notes: PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S players can play together since the console launch on August 19, 2025. On PS5 and Xbox, crossplay with PC is off by default, and turning it off keeps console players away from PC players. PC has no crossplay setting, so PC players can always meet console players. We found no 2026 change to this.
On PC, the Steam and Epic versions both use a LIPASS account, and press reports say they play together.
The mobile version (out April 2025) has its own matchmaking: phones don't play with PC or consoles.

Progress carries across PC, console and mobile through a Level Infinite Pass (LIPASS) account, which PC players need anyway. Link a LIPASS account early: Game Rant reports that progress made before linking may not sync.
toggle: On PS5 and Xbox, open the lobby menu (Options or Menu button) and go to Game, then Crossplay Toggle. There's no toggle on PC.
progress: One LIPASS account carries your progress between PC, console and mobile once it's linked.

title: Payday 2
notes: On PC, Steam and Epic Games Store players can heist together. Starbreeze added this when the game launched on Epic on June 8, 2023.

There's no crossplay between PC and consoles or between console families. The console versions stopped getting updates in 2018 (Switch never got any), so they're on different versions from PC. Progress doesn't carry between platforms.
The PS4 version is playable on PS5, and the Xbox One version runs on Xbox Series X|S. Online play on console needs PS Plus or a Game Pass tier that includes online play.

title: DayZ
notes: Update 1.29 (April 8, 2026) brought a native Xbox Series X|S version and put DayZ on the Xbox app for Windows with Xbox Play Anywhere. The Xbox store lists Xbox cross-platform and cross-gen multiplayer, so the Xbox app PC version shares servers with Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S players.

The Steam version is still separate. Bohemia ships separate patch notes for Steam, Xbox and PlayStation and often patches Steam first, and Steam isn't part of the Xbox crossplay group. Steam is the only PC version that runs mods.
PlayStation has no crossplay. The PS4 version is playable on PS5 and uses the same servers. Online play on console needs PS Plus or a Game Pass tier that includes online play.

DayZ Cool Edition came to Nintendo Switch 2 on August 20, 2026 (online only, needs Nintendo Switch Online). Bohemia hasn't said whether it shares servers with any other platform, so treat Switch 2 crossplay as unconfirmed.

title: Raft
notes: Raft came to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on December 4, 2024 with online co-op for up to 10 players across PC, PlayStation and Xbox.

On Steam, crossplay was first only on an opt-in beta branch. Update 1.1 moved it to the normal version on March 10, 2026, along with controller support and in-game voice chat. Steam players who switch to the older 1.09_precrossplayupdate branch lose crossplay.
There's no version for PS4, Xbox One or Switch.

title: Naraka: Bladepoint
notes: Players on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S can team up and add each other as friends, but only on the same regional server. NetEase's FAQ says you can't join a Gathering Hall with someone on a different platform.

NetEase's Xbox FAQ says Xbox players are always matched with Xbox app PC players and can choose whether to also play with other PC versions. At the PS5 launch in 2023, PS5 players could choose to play only with other PS5 players. NetEase hasn't published a newer breakdown of these settings.

Accounts stay on the store or platform where you made them: Steam, Epic and PS5 accounts can't be moved. The exception is Xbox, where one Xbox account works on Xbox Series X|S and the Xbox app on PC, with a shared rank.
The game went free to play and launched on PS5 on July 13, 2023. Xbox One support ended on August 28, 2024, and the game is no longer on Game Pass or Xbox Cloud Gaming.
progress: No cross-progression, except that an Xbox account is shared between Xbox Series X|S and the Xbox app on PC.
